prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Its luminous body and tail curve toward the chimney opening of an old northern German farmhouse, carrying only a few subtle floating grain kernels along its path to suggest its household wealth-bringing role. Close framing keeps the small duck head distinct; body and tail fully visible with margins. Deep blue night, warm chimney light, eerie furtive clever aura with a hint of dangerous fire, no cute mascot smile. Preserve one continuous snake body and one duck head; do not mix with dragon, chicken or kettle forms. No dragon horns, pointed teeth, reptile head, humanoid face, extra heads or extra beings. No text, labels, runes, frame or watermark. Contemporary artistic interpretation of the source-described fiery-duck-headed-snake variant.
